empty_state.title: Decision-Ready EU Labor Market Intelligence
empty_state.subtitle: Ask natural language questions about youth unemployment across EU member states, aggregates, and historic trends.
sample_queries: Which 5 EU countries had the highest youth unemployment rate in 2022?
Compare youth unemployment between Spain, Germany, and the EU aggregate from 2015 to 2023.
What was the trend of youth unemployment in France over the last 10 years?
Show me countries where youth unemployment exceeded 20% in 2020.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the layout is clean, modern, and data-focused with generous whitespace.
Use single muted EU blue (#1E40AF) as the main accent across primary buttons, highlights, and primary chart series.
Render exact auto-decided chart types: Line chart for multi-year trends and Bar chart for cross-country comparisons.
Always render the SQL query alongside or collapsible inside the Copilot answer for transparency.
Add sample prompt cards in the empty state so users can run queries with 1-click.
Attach required data-testid attributes to all interactive elements as defined in data_testing_ids.
Include schema documentation drawer or modal explaining available fields (entity, country_code, year, youth_unemployment_rate, is_eu_aggregate).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Follow generous spacing, clean line-heights, accessibility standards, data-testid on all key components, and avoid generic centered templates.
